title.en: Which infrastructure pump prints 6 cm aggregate?
title.zh: 哪台基建泵印了 6 厘米骨料？

description.en: LZ-80 prints aggregate 6 cm and below, Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h / ≤ 35 MPa and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h / ≤ 22 MPa, conveying 120 m.
description.zh: LZ-80 印了骨料 6 cm 及以下、玉柴 256 kW、高压 ≤ 65 m³/h / ≤ 35 MPa、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h / ≤ 22 MPa、输送 120 m。

h1.en: Which infrastructure pump prints 6 cm aggregate?
h1.zh: 哪台基建泵印了 6 厘米骨料？

directAnswer.en: LZ-80, and Diesel 120 prints the same 6 cm limit on a different table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists LZ-80 for high-volume diesel pumping, coarse aggregate pours up to 6 cm, and infrastructure jobs at the listed pressure modes. The engine is Yuchai 256 kW. High pressure is ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 35 MPa. Low pressure is ≤ 95 m³/h and ≤ 22 MPa. Hopper 0.6 m³. Conveying distance 120 m. Delivery height is “consult factory standard”. Weight 6800 kg.
directAnswer.zh: LZ-80。柴油120在另一张表上印了同样的 6 cm 上限。邢台河北品锦机械把 LZ-80 列为大排量柴油泵送、最大 6 cm 粗骨料浇筑，以及对照高压/低压模式的基建工程。发动机是玉柴 256 kW。高压是 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 35 MPa。低压是 ≤ 95 m³/h 和 ≤ 22 MPa。料斗 0.6 m³。输送距离 120 m。输送高度是“咨询工厂标准”。重量 6800 kg。

heading.en: High pressure and low pressure are two rows

body.en: The higher output (≤ 95 m³/h) is the low-pressure mode (≤ 22 MPa). The higher pressure (≤ 35 MPa) is the lower output (≤ 65 m³/h). Quoting 95 m³/h together with 35 MPa joins two modes the table keeps apart. The published bridge note on this site points at LZ-80 when the infrastructure job is in this high-output diesel band, and it does not name a bridge.
body.zh: 更高的输送量（≤ 95 m³/h）是低压模式（≤ 22 MPa）。更高的压力（≤ 35 MPa）对应更低的输送量（≤ 65 m³/h）。把 95 m³/h 和 35 MPa 说在一起，是把表上分开的两种模式接上了。本站已发布的桥梁说明在这一档大排量柴油上指向 LZ-80，并且没有桥的名字。

heading.en: 120 m is not a missing height

body.en: Conveying distance is 120 m. The height cell is explicitly deferred to the factory standard. Do not copy Diesel 120’s 500 m vertical or Electric 80’s 300 m vertical into that blank. Stone above 6 cm is outside both LZ-80 and Diesel 120.
body.zh: 输送距离是 120 m。高度格明确交给工厂标准。不要把柴油120的垂直 500 m 或电动80的垂直 300 m 填进空白。超过 6 cm 的石子，LZ-80 和柴油120都不收。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say which pressure mode you are asking about, and do not combine 95 m³/h with 35 MPa. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明你问的是哪一档压力，不要把 95 m³/h 和 35 MPa 合在一起。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.zh: 柴油120也允许 6 cm 吗？

answer.en: Yes. Both print 6 cm and below. Diesel 120’s distance is 150 m / 500 m and its output cell is 100 m³/h, without the LZ-80 dual-mode split.
answer.zh: 是。两台都印 6 cm 及以下。柴油120的距离是 150 m / 500 m，输送量格是 100 m³/h，没有 LZ-80 那种双模式拆分。

question.en: Is the delivery height zero or unknown?
question.zh: 输送高度是零还是未知？

answer.en: The cell says consult the factory standard. It is not a published number, and it is not zero.
answer.zh: 这一格写的是咨询工厂标准。它不是已公布的数字，也不是零。

answer.en: No. It is a diesel trailer pump. Sprayers print particle sizes in millimetres.
answer.zh: 不是。它是柴油拖泵。喷涂机印的是毫米粒径。
